text:
sec-bot: ALERT: low-level HTTP parser vuln found in libproxy-httpx v3.8.0 (CVE-2024-XXXX). Affects Dedicated and Private runtime images built before 2024-07-01. Immediate mitigation required.

marta: Quick summary of required steps?

sec-bot: 1) Rebuild runtime images with libproxy-httpx >=3.8.1 and publish patched tags. 2) Rotate long-lived connector/service-account keys issued before 2024-07-01. 3) Apply temporary header-normalization WAF rule at edge. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/sec/runbooks/libhttpx (internal)

oliver: Hosted fleet already patched this morning, so Hosted API not impacted. I'll inventory Dedicated clusters now.

ashley: Detection snippets:
```
# images with old base
kubectl get pods -A -o jsonpath='{range .items}{.spec.containers[*].image}\n{end}' | grep libproxy-httpx || true
```

ops-bot: Scheduling connector rotation job: rotate-174200 for us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Start: 2024-04-05T02:00Z.

marta: Oncall plan: 1.5h sprints. Leads: @ashley (rollout), @oliver (inventory), @marta (verification). Post updates every 30m.

ashley: Kicking rolling updates for dedicated pools (maxUnavailable=1). Monitor with rollout status and smoke tests.

ops-bot: Connectors rotated in us-west-2; keys revoked. Remaining: ap-southeast-1.

marta: Legal/CS prepare advisory draft for Dedicated customers; wait to send until ~80% patched unless customer-visible errors seen.

ashley: us-west-2 done, smoke tests green. Moving to next region.

ops-bot: Patch completion: 100% Dedicated clusters patched at 1742003000. Moving to monitoring.

sec-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Postmortem owner: marta. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/sec/incidents/libhttpx-174200 (internal)
